title: SCATS diagnostic interpretation
question: What traffic and signal-operation abnormalities have been identified at this intersection, how do they relate to one another, and what should the traffic engineer investigate first?
invocation: Direct, from a map click on a Red intersection. No semantic matching or parameter extraction.
source_fields: saved Q1 result (approaches, current/usual volume, 10th-90th percentile range, direction, % difference)
saved Q3 result (cycle length, cycle stability, phase service per approach, statuses)
execution_path: No data retrieval. Reads the saved, validated Q1/Q3 results of the screening run.
input: evidence object built by templates/d001.py from the run record
missing_data: Components that were INSUFFICIENT DATA are named as not assessed; no value is inferred.
constraints: Report every affected approach and the measure that is unusual.
Do not assume the Q1 approach is the Q3 phase-service approach; connect them only when the approach is the same.
Association is not causation: an abnormal signal measure does not prove SCATS caused the traffic issue.
Do not reclassify the intersection, invent figures, write database queries or propose automatic timing changes.
Suggested checks are conservative (review, investigate, verify, check, monitor) and tied to visible evidence.

title: TomTom road-user performance confirmation
question: Which approaches are experiencing the greatest TomTom-reported delay and queue length during the selected period, and do these correspond with the approaches identified by the SCATS screening and diagnosis?
invocation: Direct, from the same map click.
source_fields: InfluxDB IntersectionTurnKpi: ApproachDelaySec, ControlDelaySec, MultiStopRate, TurnRatioPct, SampleCount
TomTom ApproachId -> EGRESS link mapping file
Q1/Q3 affected approaches from the screening run
execution_path: Fixed retrieval of the two TomTom measurements for the same 30-minute period; code computes metrics, ranking and the SCATS comparison. The TomTom Junction Analytics API (queue) is disabled in this version.
missing_data: Missing approaches or movements are reported as partial coverage, never as zero. Without data: 'TomTom confirmation unavailable for this intersection or analysis period.'
constraints: State whether the greatest delay is on the SCATS-identified approach; report a mismatch.
Highest among observed approaches is not historically abnormal delay.
Do not assert that signal settings caused congestion, queues or delay.
